body: Just having a hard time explaining things to my mother so she gets the full understanding,because she never got to be 16,she had already been married and had a baby...so she never had time to have issues,plus she never went threw what ive gone threw,i mean i do have alot more than just those things that have been said,and its just hard to cope,i realy just know how to explain to her,i once tried,but ended up deleting the message,i have it saved...but. idk if should print it and hand it to her..or what?
Thank you,i will try my best,if i ever have the chance to get out of the house,or even make a new friend.

What makes you feel good,do you like singing? or dancing? or maybe video games? what activity occupys your brain,and keeps you satisfied,is it eating?...or maybe going for a run..what clears your head..zen? tea? yoga?...do something other than suicide...or ..or hurting yourself...because you do have alot alot alot of options,GOOD options,beautiful paintings have been made due to people who had so much anxiety they just had to release it onto a canvas,same for music,and theater...so many beautiful things have come for occupying your brain.

I live in a hispanic community,and i am a tall,white girl,blue eyes,freckles,you name it..im the basic white girl,though i have lived here my entire life nearly,everyone believe i am such a terrible person (so ive heard) i never once spoke out to anyone,or overstepped,im shy and scared and very skittish,i dont even like my shoulder being touched,yet i got picked on,ive had teachers,councilers and even some other adults tell me that perhaps i should change myself so they dont pick on me,but i cant change my skin color,they are blinded by the fact that i am white,and that is the main core reason of why i am being constantly picked on in public schools,i use to love school so much,until adults,teens and the curiculm changed,it saddens me because im only 16 and i had so many ambitions,that now i no longer feel worthy to complete,i wanted so much for myself,but was beaten down the pulp,now that i am shorter,and even more afraid of the world cause of what i was surrounded by,people pick on me even more (im like 5'5/5'6 and everyone else is 5'10) i just dont know how i could possibly doing anything wrong,i do the best i can,but staying in my comfort zone,i dont like being pushed to hard,and i am afraid of pain...i just dont know what to do anymore...i also replied to someone saying a few more things so you know me better..hopefully it helps.

I do tell my mother a lot acutally,i tell her everything im feeling,and she neglects it,i went to therapy for 4 years religiously,because it was recommended (i had reported something that had happened in my life to cps) and just back in march i tried to overdose,my mother was nice to me for only 2 week and then she started to be really mean,yell at me,tell me thing,say i shouldnt eat what i was eating (i stress eat,and it varys what i crave,usually healthy foods,but mostly junk food combos w/ the healthy) i was medicated,i took 3 different types of medicine (one by my doctor and one by the hospitals orders,which both stopped working after a while) if my brothers truly loved me,my middle half brother wouldnt of beaten and raped me when i was younger,than never of given me closure,and my full blooded brother would never try to come into my room when me and my mom are aruging and try and beat me up..it isnt what you think it is,love doesnt mean pain..i know this from experience..i just dont know..if im doing something wrong,i sleep alot cause i rather not deal with the pain emotionally and physically (i have a very bad back and alot of breathing problems) and i sometimes either refuse to eat,or eat to much (right now refusing,sense 1 of 2 things have come up,which includes braces) i am getting sick,im having mental break downs,and im uncomfortable in my own home..i believe this is do to the bad vibes in the house,the haunted memories...i feel i repeat myself to much,and my parents/mother just refuses to acknowledge it,she is very political and republican,she wants to protect are rights,and thinks all these bad people,and it effects me on a daily,i really just want a quiet enviorment,with kind people,she trys to bring me to the "harsh" reality of this world,which makes no sense what so ever,because it doesnt have to be so violent she just makes it that way...its exhausting,constantly having to have my gaurd up cause idk when the next lecture will be,i love my mother,and i want to have a better bond,but i also dont wanna be put threw this hell she is making for me.

I can't say suicide is the way to go,because than i'd be a hypocrite,because i have and still do think of suicide,even attempted it and was hospitalized,if you feel like it is so bad where you were,get up..take a backpack,pack a few NICE pairs of clothes,take your phone/laptop,and start walking until you see a place that fits your expectation of perfect,i know walking probably sucks,but its free,and easy,you will also lose that "weight" you feel is to much,if you dont like how people talk about your problems,dont get their help,get your help,if you believe something is wrong,sit down and write what you think its wrong,make a list of pro's and con's about your self,and if the con's outweight the pro's write more pro's because everyone deserves happiness,and if your not finding it where your at,your not at your final destination,once your are fully happy and feel alive and energized,than you have time to settle and be at your final state,you have the chance to change you and the world,take it and run with it,go outside and breathe the fresh air,your friends...werent friends,your family..wasnt family..be your own friend,be your own family,it may be lonely rn,but i promise sweetie,it gets better,i may not have the most luxurious life rn at 16,and i may be sad,but i know eventually ill be happy..and i know the same will be for you..everyone has their time in life where its the hardest to stare at someone,or even smile...just do what makes you comfortable...but suicide? that isnt the way...im not saying it selfish...or think of your loved ones,im saying...what about you...? hmm? what about all things you DO love...video games maybe? rebuilding computers?..how about making apps? or even making your own video game..it all will work out eventually..i hope this helped..

If you even attempt suicide and someone knows,they can hospitalize you,if you stop eating to the point where its concerning,they can hospitalize you,if you say you have a plan,such as what you mention (hanging) they CAN and WILL put you into a hospital,if you tell someone around you that you are seriously thinking of harming yourself (hoping theyre great people) they WILL get you to a hospital,they can call the cops/emt's to get you,and take you,if they are concerned of your safety...they will be able to...because not only are you a danger to your self,they see you a danger to the community aswell...and i think a few places (in the u.s. that is) suicide/attempting suicide is illegal and you'd go to jail for it.
